smoke.description: For harness smoke tests only: proves prepare, run, grade, scan and evaluate end to end as cheaply as possible. Pair with a Codex Luna author and a Claude Haiku reviewer and spec review (setup follows the author), medium effort, two reviews, ten turns and no retro. Its results are not comparable with other variants.
